name: stepfun-tts
description: >- Generates Chinese/Japanese speech with StepFun's Contextual TTS — default stepaudio-2.5-tts, stepaudio-3-tts for whisper/inline-() prosody. Replaces step-tts-2's voice_label with natural-language instruction. Use for emotional/prosody-controlled synthesis, batch voice lines, migrating from step-tts-2, or cloned voices (2.5/step-tts-2, not v3). Triggers on 阶跃 TTS, 语音合成, 配音. Not for transcription (use stepfun-asr).
author: daymade
